newsitem.title: USA: SITEL Corp to acquire Swedish telemarketer.
newsitem.headline: SITEL Corp to acquire Swedish telemarketer.

text.p: SITEL Corp said Friday it has reached an agreement to acquire Svanberg & Co Intressenter AB, a telemarketing service provider in Sweden, for a combination of cash and SITEL common stock.
Specific terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Svanberg & Co is a privately held company with headquarters in Orebro, Sweden, and annualized revenues of about $4 million, SITEL, a telephone-based customer service and sales provider, said.
SITEL shares were down 15/16 at 15-1/2 Friday.
